newsitem.title: USA: Britain may switch money to education in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Britain may switch money to education in 1998.

text.p: The British government might switch some money from the social security budget into education in fiscal year 1998/99, government officials said on Sunday.

But Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown told a news conference that the comprehensive spending review he has launched will "not dramatically affect" departmental spending plans either this budget year or next.

Brown was commenting during the Group of Seven summit on a British newspaper report that the government might switch money between departments in the current financial year to focus on its priorities of jobs and education.
He said the position remained that the government would not conduct a public spending round this year aimed at reallocating resources across ministries.
Brown said the first departmental examinations being conducted as part of the comprehensive spending review would be completed by October.
